# 35th Japan Record Awards

The 35th Annual Japan Record Awards took place at the Nippon Budokan in Chiyoda, Tokyo, 31 December 1993, starting at 6:30PM JST. The primary ceremonies were televised in Japan on TBS.
Award winners
*Japan Record Award:
**Kaori Kozai for "Mugonzaka"
*Best Vocalist:
**Kiyoshi Maekawa
*Best New Artist:
**Yasuhiro Yamane
*Best Album:
**Mariya Takeuchi for "Quiet Life"
References
*Steve McClure. "35th Japan Record Award Winners Are Announced". Billboard. 29 January 1994. [https://books.google.co.uk/books?id=HQgEAAAAMBAJ&pg=PA50#v=onepage&q&f=false p 50].
*レコード大賞 復権へ再改革. The Asahi Shimbun. 付東京夕刊. 18 December 1993. p 14.
